calculations.formula: TTM CFO - all cash PPE - finance lease principal - SBC
limitations: Economic-cost cash proxy, not FCFF or supported owner earnings.
Retains total capex. SBC cost method: no additional future dilution penalty or settlement-tax deduction.
CFO includes current-period working capital, cash taxes and interest; sustainable normalizations unresolved.

calculations.formula: C = TTM CFO - TTM SBC - M - Delta

assumptions.description: M is assumed at 50%, 75%, or 100% of TTM total cash capex, including lease principal. These are arbitrary analytical settings, not source estimates or plausible confidence bounds.
Delta=-10000,0,+10000 is assumed aggregate normalization for working capital, cash taxes, other recurring economic cash needs and cash restrictions. No data-supported bound exists.
Deduct reported SBC as economic compensation cost. Do not also deduct settlement taxes or projected dilution. Capitalized SBC/tax/economic replacement-cost bridge is not fully established.

limitations: F02/F03: no supported owner-earnings range because M and Delta are materially unbounded.
Lower maintenance is not automatically distributable: growth capex may be required competitively.

calculations.formula: raw close * (October Class A + Class B shares)/1e6
limitations: Historical secondary price observation multiplied by stale October actual shares; not exact December market cap.

calculations.formula: raw close * Q3 diluted weighted-average shares

assumptions.description: 2572m Q3 diluted weighted-average shares held fixed as illustrative denominator, not actual December diluted shares.
